facts.fact: POPSK stands for Post Office Passport Seva Kendra
facts.quote: What is a Passport Seva Kendra (PSK)/ Post Office Passport Seva Kendra (POPSK)?

facts.fact: POPSKs are extended arms of Passport Offices that render front-end passport services
facts.quote: Passport Seva Kendras and Post Office Passport Seva Kendras are extended arms of Passport Offices and render front-end services related to Passport issuance.
facts.note: Quoted from the Passport Seva portal's own content file, which the FAQ page loads; the FAQ answers sit in collapsed accordions, so the page's visible text does not show them. (https://www.passportindia.gov.in/psp/FaqWhereToApply)

facts.fact: Their functions run from token issuance to granting of the application for passport issue/re-issue
facts.quote: These Kendras cover functionalities from token issuance to granting of application for Passport issue/re-issue and other services.
facts.note: Quoted from the Passport Seva portal's own content file, which the FAQ page loads; the FAQ answers sit in collapsed accordions, so the page's visible text does not show them. (https://www.passportindia.gov.in/psp/FaqWhereToApply)

summary: Passport Seva FAQ definition of PSK/POPSK unchanged.
